Mars.1: Mars in (its own) place causes victory and wealth
Mars.2: in the second it gives honor and gold
Mars.3: in the third it produces the loss and diminution of one's gold
Mars.4: in the fourth success with regard to friends and money
Mars.5: in the fifth quarrels and the loss of one's respect and wealth
Mars.6: in the sixth diseases, foes, and deceits
Mars.7: in the seventh it destroys sickness, fatigue, and enemies
Mars.8: in the eighth Mars causes honor, glory, and wealth
Mars.9: in the ninth Mars produces unrighteous (adharma) behavior and jealousy
Mars.11: in the eleventh the acquisition of gold and sons
Mars.12: and in the twelfth the loss of one's wife and untruthful behavior

Sun.1: Mars in the place of the Sun causes work with fire (smelting)
Sun.2: in the second a bilious disease oftentimes
Sun.3: in the third the destruction of one's foes and the acquisition of copper (tamra) and gold
Sun.4: in the fourth it produces a disease of the limbs
Sun.5: in the fifth Mars produces honor and the acquisition of children
Sun.6: in the sixth victory, power, and good health
Sun.7: in the seventh diseases, wandering, and anger
Sun.8: and in the eighth an ailment caused by poison
Sun.9: in the ninth Mars produces authority, prosperity, and the destruction of one's foes
Sun.10: in the tenth injury to one's enemies
Sun.11: in the eleventh the acquisition of position, gold, and honor
Sun.12: and in the twelfth stumbling and disease

Saturn.1: Mars in the place of Saturn causes success with regard to one's deeds in battle
Saturn.2: in the second money, prosperity, and respect
Saturn.3: in the third it gives quarrels, injuries, and wounds
Saturn.4: in the fourth it produces many attainments and power
Saturn.5: in the fifth it destroys one's sons, one's enjoyment, one's happiness, and one's wealth
Saturn.6: in the sixth it gives enemies and poison
Saturn.7: in the seventh it restrains one's foes, fears, and diseases
Saturn.8: in the eighth it produces enemies, fatigue, and disease
Saturn.9: in the ninth Mars gives respect and wealth
Saturn.10: in the tenth it takes away honor and wealth
Saturn.11: in the eleventh it produces profits from one's business, goods, money, glory, and beauty
Saturn.12: and in the twelfth it gives diseases of the eyes and wandering

Jupiter.1: Mars in the place of Jupiter gives enemies, (wounds from) swords, and diseases
Jupiter.2: in the second it takes away one's thoughts
Jupiter.3: in the third it causes separation from one's relatives and calamities
Jupiter.4: in the fourth illnesses of the genitals and belly
Jupiter.5: in the fifth it gives bilious (diseases), enemies, and separations
Jupiter.6: in the sixth it produces glory, the acquisition of money, and honor
Jupiter.7: in the seventh Mars causes offensive behavior by one's wife and diseases
Jupiter.9: in the ninth Mars (produces) poverty, removal, and reproach
Jupiter.10: in the tenth the acquisition of honor, glory, and wealth
Jupiter.11: in the eleventh the acquiring of position, sons, and money
Jupiter.12: and in the twelfth disease, hunger, and sickness of the blood

Venus.1: Mars in the place of Venus causes diseases of phlegm and blood
Venus.2: in the second the fear of fire
Venus.3: in the third separation from one's wife and advisors and quarrels
Venus.4: in the fourth it gives (wounds from) swords and fire, envy, and fear
Venus.5: in the fifth it produces unkindness by one's relatives and quarrels
Venus.7: in the seventh Mars gives a wife and a hoard
Venus.8: in the eighth gold and happiness
Venus.9: in the ninth it causes a change in the blood in the body
Venus.10: in the tenth poverty and pain
Venus.11: in the eleventh Mars gives gold and a son

Mercury.1: Mars in the place of Mercury causes an increase of one's miseries and foes
Mercury.3: in the third an increase in joy and pleasure
Mercury.4: in the fourth fear of one's enemies
Mercury.5: in the fifth it gives enormous wealth and a son
Mercury.6: in the sixth glory, honor, and property
Mercury.7: in the seventh it gives illness of one's wife, roaming, fatigue, and faults
Mercury.8: in the eighth it causes imprisonment
Mercury.9: in the ninth Mars causes the loss of one's goods and disrespect
Mercury.10: in the tenth indolence, envy, and the loss of one's wealth
Mercury.11: in the eleventh the acquisition of lands and gold
Mercury.12: and in the twelfth wandering and theft

Moon.1: Mars in the place of the Moon causes grief because of kings, fire, wild animals, poison, burning, swords, diseases, distress, and the loss of one's wealth
Moon.2: in the second poverty, envy, illness, and fraud
Moon.3: in the third it produces lordship, honor, brilliance, and joy, and gives food and gold
Moon.4: in the fourth Mars causes belly-aches, fevers, the pouring forth of one's blood, and despair
Moon.5: in the fifth it gives the loss of one's sons and money, wounds, quarrels, thefts, and diseases
Moon.6: in the sixth Mars causes the destruction of one's foes, honor, joy, publicity, good health, and prosperity
Moon.7: in the seventh the loss of one's wealth and property, miseries, diseases of the belly and eyes, and poverty
Moon.8: in the eighth Mars produces illnesses, poison, enemies, sword-wounds, loss, injuries, and poverty
Moon.9: in the ninth Mars causes sword-wounds, insults, the loss of one's gold, jealousy, and wandering
Moon.10: in the tenth diseases, enemies, (wounds from) swords, quarrels, wounds, and illnesses, but afterwards success
Moon.11: in the eleventh it gives honor, sons, authority, lands, copper (tamra), gold, and brilliance, and conquers one's enemies
Moon.12: and in the twelfth Mars gives quarrels with one's wife, anxiety, diseases of the feet, sleepiness, breaking, and fatigue

Ascendant.1: Mars in the ascendent causes the destruction of one's foes and increase in one's authority, sons, lands, gold, brilliance, and joy
Ascendant.2: in the second place it destroys one's position, wealth, and brilliance, and increases one's quarrels
Ascendant.3: in the third Mars causes the appearance of strength, glory, position, good qualities, and joy
Ascendant.4: in the fourth Mars produces sword-wounds, fire-wounds, thefts, breaking, and losses
Ascendant.5: in the fifth place from the ascendent Mars causes the loss of one's money, pain of one's wife and sons, fear, and poverty
Ascendant.6: in the sixth Mars causes the destruction of one's foes, the acquisition of property, pleasure, and joy
Ascendant.7: in the seventh Mars causes diseases of the genitals and eyes, an increase of bile, thefts, and the death of one's wife
Ascendant.8: in the eighth Mars gives bilious (diseases), fevers, blood-(sickness), fatigue, thieves, sword-wounds, losses, and distress
Ascendant.9: in the ninth it brings forth poverty, foes, and diseases, and destroys beauty and handsomeness
Ascendant.10: in the tenth place from the ascendent Mars produces wandering, enmity, thefts, wounds, and breaking
Ascendant.11: in the eleventh Mars gives very brilliant objects of gold or copper (tamra) and children
Ascendant.12: and in the twelfth place from the ascendent it produces diseases of the feet and eyes, wounds, and robberies
